items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, gated-product exposure, and rights-dependent monetization; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims substantiation, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive safeguards. Exact decision: retain private launch gates, keep external outreach unsent, and authorize only existing bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: upstream rights are unproven; compliance is technical baseline only with 37 pass, 15 fail, 7 unknown and open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings; security, accuracy/freshness, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth. No go-live proposal is supported.

Candidate plan review: retain the three SEO/performance opportunities as deferred backlog only. Do not create or requeue production work, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, deployments, spend, monetization changes, or unsupported claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission is not site-attributable; ROI, margin, payback, and causal lift remain unknown. Analytics has permission/freshness limitations, and operational sweeps are unavailable. Parked or unreachable sites require a concrete retain-parked or bounded-launch decision and completed site-specific checklist before exposure or monetization.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed; 4 remain open. No task is closable because current API, terms, support, repository, privacy, and cookie-policy artifacts provide only partial evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; operational logs and hosting data are evidence_needed. No item is clear or conditionally launchable on current evidence.

Compliance, data quality, site, analytics, revenue, and launch evidence support containment-only execution. Preserve unknowns: do not treat failed analytics as zero, aggregate revenue as site performance, or missing operations/security sweeps as clearance. Retain ordinary reversible growth only where site-specific consent, disclosures, claims, rights, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries are evidenced. No proposal or change request is retained by Legal this cycle.
